lines.text: Pip and Pop the monkey twins raced into the playground to grab the brand new tire swing!
I got here first! yelled Pip. No, I grabbed the rope first! shouted Pop!
They pulled and yanked on opposite sides, twisting the rope into an angry tangle!
Ten minutes passed, both monkeys were sweaty and red-faced, and nobody was swinging!
Mama Monkey walked over with a fun little sand-timer shaped like a smiling banana!
Pip gets three minutes to soar to the clouds, then Pop takes the pilot seat!
Pip counted his swings joyfully, and when the timer chimed, handed the swing to Pop!
Taking turns turns stubborn arguments into double the laughter and twice the fun!
Play nicely together and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
